Fakeplayer Chunkloader Addon 1.0.0
Minecraft Java 26.3 | Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ | Java 25+

Install this jar on both client and dedicated server alongside:
- Fakeplayer Chunkloader 2.1.0 for Minecraft 26.3
- Fabric API 0.160.7+26.3 or compatible newer build for 26.3

For singleplayer, install all three mods in the client mods directory.
Active Bots: F9 by default; configurable in Controls > Key Binds > Miscellaneous.
Configure opens the original bot configuration.
Enable Mob Entity Ticking separately from natural spawning for each bot.
The existing F8 Disabled Bots menu is retained.

The original mod is required and is not bundled.
